model.name: Home Lab
model.documentation: The home lab as an enterprise: why it exists (motivation), what it can do (capabilities), who uses it (business) and the roadmap. Every solution architecture under models/ builds on these elements; it is the test bed for the a4m workflow before the office network.

element.name: Backup jobs
element.documentation: Nightly restic snapshots of Nextcloud data and its database.

element.name: Backblaze B2
element.documentation: Off-site object storage for encrypted backup snapshots (being replaced).

element.name: Hetzner Storage Box
element.documentation: Off-site storage for encrypted restic snapshots, EU-hosted, flat price.

element.name: Proxmox host 01
element.documentation: Mini PC hypervisor; the only compute host (see enterprise/bus-asm-single-host).

element.name: VM docker-01
element.documentation: Shared Docker host for containerised solutions.

element.name: NAS
element.documentation: Synology NAS holding solution data (NFS) and running backup jobs.

element.name: Pi-hole
element.documentation: Network-wide DNS resolver with ad and tracker blocking.

element.name: Home lab hardware
element.documentation: Hypervisor, NAS, network gear and UPS (see the compute and network SAs).

element.name: Family
element.documentation: Household members using files, photos and smart-home dashboards.

element.name: Home lab admin
element.documentation: Runs and maintains the home lab.

element.name: Port the home lab model to the office
element.documentation: Copy the repo, model the office SAs under models/, switch the LLM assistant to GitHub Copilot.

element.name: Family
element.documentation: Everyone in the household who relies on the self-hosted services.

element.name: Data privacy
element.documentation: Keep family photos, documents and smart-home data off third-party clouds.

element.name: Single hypervisor is a SPOF
element.documentation: All VMs run on one Proxmox host; a hardware failure takes every service down.

element.name: Portable to the office network
element.documentation: The same tooling and patterns must be reusable for the office environment.

element.name: Architecture as code
element.documentation: The architecture lives in git as validated ArchiMate YAML; diagrams are generated.

element.name: Home Assistant
element.documentation: Smart-home automation, dashboards and device integrations.

element.name: Jellyfin
element.documentation: Media server streaming the family's videos and music to TVs and phones.

element.name: UPS
element.documentation: 900 VA line-interactive UPS; ~20 minutes runtime for host, NAS and network.

element.name: Nextcloud
element.documentation: Self-hosted file sync, sharing and photo backup for the family.

element.name: Nextcloud web
element.documentation: Web UI, WebDAV and mobile sync endpoints.

element.name: Nextcloud database
element.documentation: Metadata, shares and user accounts.

element.name: Nextcloud cache
element.documentation: File locking and session cache.

element.name: User files
element.documentation: Family files and photos, stored on the NAS over NFS.
